description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminPanel page in an Online Examination System. It contains event handlers for button clicks that perform server-side page transfers to different pages such as AdminQueue, AdminLeaderboard, SetExam, EditExam, and LoginPage.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: A web page class for the admin control panel, handling navigation between different administrative pages.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for home button click; currently empty.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for profile button click; transfers control to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for leaderboard button click; transfers control to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for set exam button click; transfers control to SetExam.aspx.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for edit exam button click; transfers control to EditExam.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for logout button click; transfers control to LoginPage.aspx.
